name: How long does the finish carpentry phase take during a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does the finish carpentry phase take during a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom finish carpentry scope usually takes one to three days on-site. The total schedule depends on whether the trim work involves simple casing and baseboards or complex custom shelving and decorative wainscoting. Timing also relies on job site readiness: tile setting, wall painting, and plumbing rough-ins must be completed before final trim can be installed, caulked, and sealed. Any custom cabinetry built off-site requires additional lead time before arrival.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry in a bathroom typically takes one to three days on-site, depending on the complexity of custom built-ins, molding detail, and site readiness.
